authority.ruling: Explicitly admits753a78/753b20 asD10c: whole PS2 MPEG/IPU decoder(IPU_CTRL/IPU_CMD) positively replaced by CRI Mana/USM decoder with direct decoder evidence; elementary-condition pairing is not required for diagnostics of a removed decoder.

required_seams.action: Golden mode must not retain753a78/753b20 or the old SCE MPEG/IPU decoder, IPU control/command protocol and old error callback aliases. Use the complete real Golden native movie filename selection/USM/player/work allocation/start/poll/frame/draw/audio/stop/release/error lifecycle. Do not suppress actual native codec/format failures, fake playback success or disable movies. Original PS2 hardware decoder/diagnostics remain unchanged.

Runtime GoldenM6b qualification remains required for all direct/translated/native/inlined/computed consumers. NSO/private evidence are static only, never runtime dependencies; unrelated codec/default banks remain undecided.
